values.note: City of Babbitt: daily (Sunday-Thursday) $65 a night, weekends and holidays $80, plus tax; tent site $35. Seasonal $3,500 (regular) or $3,800 (preferred). Cancellations are non-refundable unless travel protection was bought.

fees.source: https://www.babbittmn.gov/community-info/campground ('Daily: $65/night + tax', 'Daily (weekend/holidays): $80/night + tax', 'Tent Site: $35/night + tax', 'Regular Seasonal: $3,500', 'Preferred Seasonal: $3,800') + rules PDF ('All cancellations are non-refundable unless travel protection was purchased'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Booked online (ResNexus). Weekend bookings need Friday and Saturday; holiday bookings need 3 nights. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out noon. At most six adults, or two adults and minor children, a site.

booking.source: https://www.babbittmn.gov/community-info/campground ('CLICK HERE TO MAKE A RESERVATION' -> resnexus.com; 'Weekend Booking require a 2-night minimum (Friday & Saturday) & Holiday Bookings require a 3-night minimum') + rules PDF (check-in/out, 'A maximum of six (6) adults or two (2) adults and minor children permitted per campsite'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: https://www.babbittmn.gov/community-info/campground ('we offer full hook up sites') + rules PDF ('released appropriately into the provided sewer hook-up at each site'), read 2026-11-11; amperage not stated

facilities.source: https://www.babbittmn.gov/community-info/campground ('a full-service shower house/restroom, a camp store that offers firewood, ice, soft drinks...') + rules PDF ('Showers: Open 24 hours a day'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Babbitt campground (opened 2023) among pines at 1967 Scott Rd, within walking distance of Birch Lake, the public beach, the Heartland ATV Trail and a paved bike path; fish-cleaning house and extra parking for boat trailers and ATVs. 28 seasonal sites plus 19 daily/weekly/monthly transient sites and one tent site. ATVs may be driven only between sites and the trail. --Claude
summary: City page and rules PDF read: $65 Sun-Thu / $80 weekends and holidays + tax, seasonal $3,500-3,800, full hookups with sewer at each site, shower house, camp store, ResNexus booking with a 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum. Both stored websites are dead (one parked, one 404); the city site moved to babbittmn.gov. ResNexus unread, so amperage, lengths, season and occupancy are unconfirmed; the 48-site split is still only from the old note.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (ATV rule): the city's own page says the campground is 'within walking distance to Birch Lake and Babbitt's public beach, Heartland ATV Trail' and that 'Our facilties also house a fish cleaning house and extra parking for boat trailers and ATVs'; the rules PDF says 'All ATV's and golf carts must be operated within state and local guidelines. ATV's may be driven to and from campsites only.' This is the operator's (City of Babbitt) own wording. It is a town campground near a lake and a bike path, not an OHV staging area, but it does provide ATV parking and lets ATVs ride from the sites to the trail. Reviewer to decide.

Websites: stored https://babbittcampground.com/ is a parked GoDaddy domain (redirects to /lander, a 'parking' page) and https://www.babbitt-mn.com/campground answers 404 (babbitt-mn.com now redirects to babbittmn.gov). Replace both with https://www.babbittmn.gov/community-info/campground (200, City of Babbitt, this campground).
Missing phone: (218) 235-9875, the 'CONTACT US' number on the city campground page, also on Google Maps. City Hall is (218) 827-3464.

Long-stay (local, but seasonal-heavy): the city posts nightly rates and books nights online, and the stored note's split (28 seasonal, 19 daily/weekly/monthly transient, 1 tent) puts about 40% of sites on nightly sale, which passes test 4. The split came from the old, now-parked babbittcampground.com and could not be re-read; occupancy on ResNexus is unread (captcha).
Price: $65 Sun-Thu, $80 weekends + tax. The price gate does not apply to a city campground, but it is the highest base rate in this batch.

Google Maps: 'Babbitt Campground and RV Park', 4.7 from 35 reviews, 1967 Scott Rd, (218) 235-9875; Google's pin 47.71391,-91.89135 is about 180 m NNW of the stored pin, which sits on Scott Road. Imagery predates the 2023 campground, so the loop can't be seen; no move proposed (under 250 m), but 47.7139,-91.8914 is the better point if one is wanted.
